description: A ref:// link in a message opens the code it points at, snapshotted when the message was sent.
agent_instructions:
Switchboard renders ref:// links as code snapshots attached at send time. Only the `full` string of `channel_reply` and `notify_human` is scanned. Refs in other fields, crosstalk, code fences, and inline code are ignored.
Use a root-relative path, then optional colon-separated scope and name segments. Bare paths use the project root. `/x` uses the filesystem root. `~/x` uses home. A segment may end in `[n]` to choose the nth same-named declaration in document order. `arguments` names a function parameter list; `arguments:name` names one parameter.
Use `#text` without a chain for files without symbols, a region inside a scope, or a path outside the project root. A chain on an outside path is refused and names the `#text` form. Escape spaces and close parentheses, or wrap the destination in angle brackets.
The lexicon must return one hash-verified declaration for `exact`. A missing or ambiguous name refuses the send and gives a paste fix. The refusal lists complete candidate refs, or what was declared where the chain stopped. Only lexicon ABSENCE degrades: the reply carries a notice and the snapshot is `fuzzy` or `unresolved` with a reason.
